title: Temporary Jobs for Hawkers and Their Assistants when Hawker Centres Close for Renovation and Repair
what_it_is: Temporary Jobs for Hawkers and Their Assistants when Hawker Centres Close for Renovation and Repair

sections.label: Hawker centre closure support measures
sections.summary: Centres may close up to three months for R&R works, with rental remission, training grants, employment help and an NEA information centre.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: During such works, the centres may be closed for up to three months.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Stallholders who are unable to operate their stalls due to the closure of the centres are usually granted rental remission for the duration of the closure due to the R&R works.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Stallholders who wish to take the opportunity to attend training can apply for courses and training grants through SkillsFuture Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Those who wish to explore temporary employment may also visit Workforce Singapore's career centres or its online job matching portal, Jobs Bank, for employment assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: NEA will set up a one-stop Information and Service Centre for hawkers in the second half of this year.
